name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No active Atlantic storms; low south of Bermuda has a 40% chance of forming
state: The National Hurricane Center showed no active Atlantic systems on 3 Nov. It gives a low expected to form south of Bermuda a 20% chance of development in 48 hours and 40% in seven days; it is forecast to drift east over the open Atlantic (Spokesman-Review, 3 Nov). The season ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No threat to land; check the National Hurricane Center for any change before travel to the Caribbean.
rubric_hit: No storm threatening land within 5 days = Normal

sources.title: NOAA NHC — Atlantic 7-day tropical weather outlook
Spokesman-Review — Hurricane center increases odds for potential Atlantic system

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
rubric.normal: No hurricane active, or none threatening land within 5 days.
